summary.text: Everett Jackson, a Republican small business owner and community organizer, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the open Texas 30th District seat to Frederick Haynes III.
He advanced from the March 2026 Republican primary and won the May 26, 2026 runoff over Sholdon Daniels.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Jackson as also known as "Pharaoh."
The March 3, 2026 Republican primary also included Sholdon Daniels, Gregor Heise and Nils Walker, and Jackson advanced to a runoff, in which he defeated Daniels on May 26, 2026.
He received 17.4% of the vote to Frederick Haynes III's 82.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
